mapper.insert: insert into expert_profile_update_suggestion (evidence_id, user_id, status, summary, confidence, generation_mode, prompt_version, model_name, agent_output_json, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{evidenceId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{summary}, #{confidence}, #{generationMode}, #{promptVersion}, #{modelName}, #{agentOutputJson}, 0, sysdate(), sysdate())

insert into expert_profile_update_suggestion_item (suggestion_id, dimension_code, dimension_name, before_score, suggested_score, reason, evidence, confidence, create_time) values (#{suggestionId}, #{dimensionCode}, #{dimensionName}, #{beforeScore}, #{suggestedScore}, #{reason}, #{evidence}, #{confidence}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select suggestion_id, evidence_id, user_id, status, summary, reviewed_summary, confidence, generation_mode, prompt_version, model_name, agent_output_json, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, review_comment, release_id, version, create_time, resolved_time from expert_profile_update_suggestion where evidence_id = #{evidenceId} limit 1

select s.suggestion_id, s.evidence_id, s.user_id, p.real_name, s.status, s.summary, s.reviewed_summary, s.confidence, s.generation_mode, s.prompt_version, s.model_name, s.agent_output_json, s.reviewer_id, s.reviewer_name, s.review_comment, s.release_id, s.version, s.create_time, s.resolved_time from expert_profile_update_suggestion s left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = s.user_id where s.suggestion_id = #{suggestionId}

select s.suggestion_id, s.evidence_id, s.user_id, p.real_name, s.status, s.summary, s.reviewed_summary, s.confidence, s.generation_mode, s.prompt_version, s.model_name, s.agent_output_json, s.reviewer_id, s.reviewer_name, s.review_comment, s.release_id, s.version, s.create_time, s.resolved_time from expert_profile_update_suggestion s left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = s.user_id where s.suggestion_id = #{suggestionId} for update

select s.suggestion_id, s.evidence_id, s.user_id, p.real_name, s.status, s.summary, s.reviewed_summary, s.confidence, s.generation_mode, s.prompt_version, s.model_name, s.agent_output_json, s.reviewer_id, s.reviewer_name, s.review_comment, s.release_id, s.version, s.create_time, s.resolved_time from expert_profile_update_suggestion s left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = s.user_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.status = 'APPROVED' order by s.resolved_time desc, s.suggestion_id desc limit #{limit}

select item_id, suggestion_id, dimension_code, dimension_name, before_score, suggested_score, approved_score, reason, reviewed_reason, evidence, confidence from expert_profile_update_suggestion_item where suggestion_id = #{suggestionId} order by item_id
mapper.update: update expert_profile_update_suggestion set reviewed_summary = #{reviewedSummary}, update_time = sysdate() where suggestion_id = #{suggestionId} and status = 'PENDING'

update expert_profile_update_suggestion set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, review_comment = #{comment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, release_id = #{releaseId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, version = version + 1, resolved_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where suggestion_id = #{suggestionId} and status = 'PENDING' and version = #{version}
update expert_profile set graph_version = #{graphVersion}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
